title: [finding] plugin-audit: `planTrackedLookupReads` and the milestone planner both admit `user` then require the materialized `reference` — a trackHistory'd implicit-target field is planned for nobody and the timeline shows the raw id (#19198's shape, one package over, TWO sites)
body:
Filed by the `domain:services` execution seat (#6021), `session_01AhQASwqJr2Z7XfGWUdvnbF`, while reviewing PR #19263 (card #19198). ⛔ Ungraded, ⛔ unrouted — priority and lane are triage's.

⚠️ **Residue surfaced by executing #19198, ⛔ not a defect of that delivery.** Per H52 it is filed as its own card and linked back rather than widening #19198's file surface.

## The defect — the #19198 shape, one package over

`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts` admits `user` as a reference type and then **requires the materialized carrier**, so a `trackHistory`'d `{ type: 'user' }` field authored without an explicit `reference` is planned for **nobody** — and the timeline then renders the raw id.

```
:364  const REFERENCE_FIELD_TYPES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['lookup', 'master_detail', 'user']);
```

🔴 **TWO carrier-gated planner sites, ⛔ not one.** Both carry the identical gate:

| site | function | the gate |
|---|---|---|
| **`:471-473`** | `planTrackedLookupReads` | `if (!REFERENCE_FIELD_TYPES.has(field.type)) continue;` then `const reference = typeof field.reference === 'string' ? field.reference.trim() : ''; if (!reference) continue;` |
| **`:628-630`** | the milestone-token planner | the same two lines, verbatim |

⭐ The third `REFERENCE_FIELD_TYPES` use, **`:434` in `displayFieldValue`**, does ⛔ **not** gate on the carrier — it maps ids through `titlesFor` and falls back to the raw id. ⇒ that is the **consumer where the symptom surfaces**, not a third defect site: the planners never fetched the title, so the consumer has nothing to map.

`referenceTargetOf` is **not imported in this file at all**.

## Why the contract says this is wrong

`IMPLICIT_REFERENCE_TARGETS` (`packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts:165-168`), verbatim on `origin/main`:

> The target is a CONSTANT OF THE TYPE, so `reference` on a `user` field materializes that constant; it does not supply it. Metadata authored without it (hand-written JSON, an AI author, a Studio form) is fully specified, not under-specified.

⇒ requiring the carrier is not a stricter reading of the contract; it is the opposite of what the contract says, on the one member the contract names. This is the same reasoning triage recorded when grading #19198.

⚠️ **And the two packages are now out of step.** `audit-writers.ts`'s own docblock declares it shares this vocabulary with approvals — 「one vocabulary for "this value is a reference", not two」 — while PR #19263 moves approvals to `referenceTargetOf` and leaves audit on the raw carrier.

## The symptom this reproduces

The failure is **silent**: no refusal, no diagnostic — the field is simply absent from the read plan and the timeline shows `oBK25…` where every other reference field shows a name. ⛔ That is the shape 北极星 clause 4 names (「永不静默」), and it is the same user-visible symptom #7230 fixed for a different cause.

## Remedy

Ask `referenceTargetOf` at both planner sites instead of reading `field.reference` raw — the one-line change #19263 made in approvals, applied twice.

⚠️ ⛔ **`tree` stays out.** It is the fourth member of `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES`, and this file already states the exclusion deliberately (「tree is NOT on the list: it carries no reference」). Admitting it would *widen* what is tracked rather than repair what was silently dropped — the same line #19263 held.

## Readings, all on `origin/main` in this act (2026-09-20T08:00Z)

| reading | result |
|---|---|
| the three `REFERENCE_FIELD_TYPES` use sites | `:434` (consumer, no carrier gate) · **`:471`** · **`:628`** — the last two carrier-gated |
| `referenceTargetOf` / `referenceCarrierOf` in `audit-writers.ts` | **0 occurrences** |
| positive control — is `referenceTargetOf` a real, importable symbol? | **yes**, used in ≥6 modules (`metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, `objectql/src/engine.ts`, `objectql/src/integrity/dangling-reference-audit.ts`, …) ⇒ the zero above is a reading, ⛔ not a dead search |

⭐ **Scope note, stated because it was nearly wrong.** The delivering agent reported this as a single site (`:472`). This seat re-read the whole file rather than the named line and found **two**. Recorded because understating a site count from a report is precisely the error this seat made on #18973 earlier in this shift — the remedy is opening the file, not trusting the number.

## Dedupe

All **537**-odd open non-PR issues are the corpus used for #19198/#19252 dedupe this shift; dedupe words for this one:
`plugin-audit tracked lookup user implicit target` · `planTrackedLookupReads reference carrier gate` · `trackHistory user field raw id timeline` · `audit-writers REFERENCE_FIELD_TYPES referenceTargetOf`

⛔ Not a duplicate of **#19198** (different package, different function, and #19198's repair does not reach this file) and ⛔ not of **#7230** (same user-visible symptom, different cause).
